text: Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. One-page site. Must-haves, each one will be checked: today's opening hours are highlighted automatically; the pre-order form shows a running total in rupees; the loyalty section shows 10 stamp circles with the 10th marked FREE; every menu item shows a price; the location section has a "Get directions" link; the page works at 360px wide.

@Requester Not enough to build yet. The brief gives the checks but not the content they depend on: hours, menu, address and where pre-orders go.
1. What are the opening hours for each day of the week (open and close times, and any closed days)?
2. List every menu item with its price in rupees, grouped as you want them shown. The pre-order form will use the same items.
3. What is the full street address of Brew Lab, or the Google Maps link, to use for the "Get directions" link?
4. When a customer submits the pre-order form, where should the order go?
   Option 1: WhatsApp number
   Option 2: Email address
   Option 3: Show an on-page confirmation only (no delivery)
Paused: Identity is waiting on the Requester (J2.a: not enough information to work yet). Site v0 is in the preview. Answer Identity's question above to continue.

1. Hours: Monday to Friday 8am to 10pm, Saturday and Sunday 9am to 11pm. No closed days.

2. Menu (prices in ₹):
Coffee: Espresso 120, Cappuccino 180, Pour-over 220
Cold: Cold brew 200
Food: Croissant 150, Banana bread 130

3. Address: 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038.
Get directions link: https://maps.google.com/?q=100+Feet+Road+Indiranagar+Bengaluru+560038

4. Option 1: WhatsApp +91 98450 00000. Pay at pickup, pickup within 15 minutes of ordering.
@Adaptation Enough to build. Charter recorded from the brief and your answers. Nothing is left to be confirmed, and nothing from the brief was dropped.
@Adaptation Charter valid: statement present, 7 checkable done-when items. Work can start.

@Priority Five workflows cover all 7 done-when items for 75 of the 80 budget. Each section carries its own mobile CSS (no separate styling workflow). That leaves 5, so a later fix (8) would need your approval.

proposal.name: Menu section
proposal.goal_gap: Site has no menu; customers cannot see items or prices.
proposal.expected_outcome: A menu section with Coffee, Cold and Food groups, every item shown with its ₹ price, plus the page shell and base CSS for 360px and 1280px.

base page shell and mobile-first CSS
proposal.completion_check: Section lists Espresso 120, Cappuccino 180, Pour-over 220, Cold brew 200, Croissant 150, Banana bread 130, each with ₹; no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px.

proposal.name: Opening hours with today highlight
proposal.goal_gap: Site does not show hours or which day is today.
proposal.expected_outcome: An hours section listing Mon-Fri 8am-10pm and Sat-Sun 9am-11pm, with JavaScript highlighting today's row from the visitor's current day.
outputs: hours section in the site file
proposal.completion_check: All seven days are listed with the correct times; the row matching the browser's current day has a highlight class; no JS errors on load; no overflow at 360px and 1280px.

proposal.name: Pre-order form with running total and WhatsApp
proposal.goal_gap: Customers cannot pre-order or see a total.
proposal.expected_outcome: A form with the same six items and prices as the menu, quantity inputs, a live ₹ total, and submit opening a WhatsApp message to +91 98450 00000 with items and total. It states pay at pickup and pickup within 15 minutes of ordering.
outputs: pre-order section in the site file
proposal.completion_check: Changing quantities updates the ₹ total immediately; submit opens a wa.me link to 919845000000 containing the chosen items and total; pay-at-pickup and 15-minute pickup text is visible; no JS errors; no overflow at 360px.

proposal.name: Loyalty stamp card
proposal.expected_outcome: A loyalty section with 10 stamp circles, the 10th marked FREE.
outputs: loyalty section in the site file
proposal.completion_check: Exactly 10 stamp circles render; the 10th shows the text FREE; no overflow at 360px (circles wrap).

proposal.name: Location and directions
proposal.expected_outcome: A location section with the address 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038 and a Get directions link to the supplied Google Maps URL.
outputs: location section in the site file
proposal.completion_check: Address text matches exactly; a link labelled Get directions has href https://maps.google.com/?q=100+Feet+Road+Indiranagar+Bengaluru+560038; no overflow at 360px.
